Love that, Ana. Slow and clean is how the change gets smooth later. Tomorrow at 7, on the couch: 8 minutes of slow C landings. Press all three fingers down at once like a stamp, pick each string to check for buzz, and send a quick video of a few landings. Work for you?
ok good
